result.note: Tests the end of President's Rule in Manipur with the new Chief Minister and the composition and plans of the new government.

questions.prompt: In February 2026, who was sworn in as Chief Minister of Manipur, ending a year of President's Rule in the state?
questions.explain: Yumnam Khemchand Singh, a Meitei veteran pitched as a bridge-builder, took office on 4 February 2026. N. Biren Singh is the former Chief Minister who resigned, while Nemcha Kipgen and Losii Dikho became Deputy Chief Ministers.
questions.source: Yesterday, Yumnam Khemchand Singh was sworn in as Chief Minister, ending direct administration from New Delhi.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Manipur government sworn in in February 2026:
items: It has two Deputy Chief Ministers, one from the Kuki-Zo community and one from the Naga community.
Nemcha Kipgen is the first Kuki woman to serve as Deputy Chief Minister.
The Chief Minister's 100-day roadmap includes reviving CM da Haisi, a citizen grievance platform.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct: Nemcha Kipgen (Kuki-Zo) and Losii Dikho (Naga) are the two Deputy Chief Ministers, and CM da Haisi means "Let's tell the CM". The roadmap also covers resettlement of displaced persons and power-sharing after ethnic violence that began in May 2023.
questions.source: His 100-day roadmap includes the resettlement of displaced persons, active power-sharing, and reviving the citizen grievance platform, CM da Haisi (“Let’s tell the CM”).
